info.title: Login Fraud Detection Dataset
info.subtitle: Synthetic Login Fraud Dataset for Cybersecurity ML — Educational Use Only
info.description:
📌 Dataset: Login Fraud Detection — Synthetic Cybersecurity Dataset
👤 Developed by: Karanam Shrivasta
🎓 Platform: Kaggle | Version: 2.0

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚠️ FOR EDUCATIONAL PURPOSE ONLY
This dataset is strictly created for learning,
research, and academic purposes. No real user
data, no real IPs, no real sessions.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📊 DATASET OVERVIEW
- Rows     : 450
- Columns  : 25
- Label 0  : 270 Legitimate Logins
- Label 1  : 180 Fraudulent Logins
- Nulls    : 0
- Duplicates: 0

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔍 WHAT IS THIS DATASET?
Each row represents one web application login
session captured at network and application
layer. It simulates real-world attack patterns
including credential stuffing, brute force,
account takeover, bot login, and phishing replay.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🤖 ML USE CASES
- Binary Classification (Random Forest, XGBoost)
- Anomaly Detection (Isolation Forest)
- Feature Engineering practice
- Imbalanced Learning (SMOTE)
- SHAP Explainability

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔒 DISCLAIMER
All IPs, session IDs, timestamps and values
are 100% synthetically generated using Python
numpy and random libraries. This dataset does
NOT represent any real person, network, server
or organization.

This dataset is original and does not derive
from KDD Cup 99, CICIDS2017, NSL-KDD,
or UNSW-NB15.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📝 This report and dataset was generated by
   Karanam Shrivasta — For educational and
   non-commercial use only.
